lines.text: The root is Pos! Position, deposit.
Did you know? Pos is Latin for put.
Position: a place where something is.
Quick quiz! Which means down plus put?

words.ex: The position of the sofa makes the room look bigger.
You have to pay a deposit when you rent a flat.

publish.title: Pos root: position and deposit
publish.value: Pos comes from Latin "ponere" (to put, to place). Words: position and deposit. deposit = de + pos.
